MVP budget app: ASP.NET Core 10 minimal APIs/EF Core; React 18/TypeScript/Vite/Tailwind; Docker Compose. Demo: prefer simple, readable, composable code. `src/BudgetTracker.Api/`: `Auth/`, `AntiForgery/`, `Program.cs`; Identity cookies + Static API keys. `src/BudgetTracker.Web/`: React Router v7, strict TypeScript, Axios. Features: auth, anti-forgery, user-isolated multi-tenancy, CSV import, Azure OpenAI insights, pgvector search, background recommendations. Prefer clear names over generic names like Repository, Service, Manager, etc. Avoid using comments to overexplain everything
dotnet watch run
dotnet run -p tests/BudgetTracker.Api.Tests --output detailed --filter-query "/path/to/test"
dotnet ef migrations add MigrationName
dotnet ef database update
npm run dev
npm run build
npm run lint
docker compose up -d
docker compose down
Uses Microsoft Testing Platform (not VSTest)
Test naming follows snake_case convention: `Should_do_when_something`
Integration tests use Testcontainers for isolated database testing
Mocking with NSubstitute preferred
No code comments - use descriptive method/class names instead
User isolation enforced at database query level
API keys configured via `StaticApiKeysConfiguration` section
PostgreSQL connection: `Host=localhost;Port=5432;Database=budgettracker;Username=budgetuser;Password=budgetpass123`
When one of the applications is started for testing, make sure it's stopped once finished.
